hook: Six drones, two very different stories
reel_hook: Six drones. Two very different stories.

slides.title: Iran drones target US-used base
slides.image_prompt: Small military drones crossing a dusky sky over calm Gulf water, a radar dish on a desert shoreline, two searchlight beams crossing
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran says it struck Riffa base; Bahrain says it intercepted.
WHY IT MATTERS
Second claimed Iranian attack on US assets in days.
FOR YOU
Gulf tensions rise, though Iran says a path to a US deal remains open.
slides.body: Iran says it struck Riffa base; Bahrain says it intercepted. Second claimed Iranian attack on US assets in days. Gulf tensions rise, though Iran says a path to a US deal remains open.

slides.title: Trump, Xi, Putin: first trio
slides.image_prompt: Three empty chairs around a round table in a grand hall, city skyline glowing through tall windows behind
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Trump, Xi and Putin meet Nov 19 in Shenzhen at APEC.
WHY IT MATTERS
First formal three-way US-China-Russia leaders' meeting.
FOR YOU
Nuclear arsenal cuts and Iran are on the table; Ukraine isn't, US officials say.
slides.body: Trump, Xi and Putin meet Nov 19 in Shenzhen at APEC. First formal three-way US-China-Russia leaders' meeting. Nuclear arsenal cuts and Iran are on the table; Ukraine isn't, US officials say.

slides.title: One router grounded US flights
slides.image_prompt: A single network router with tangled glowing fiber cables, tiny parked airplanes lined up beside it on a dark runway
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
A router swap overloaded FAA systems, halting US flights.
WHY IT MATTERS
More than 20,000 flights disrupted since Friday.
FOR YOU
Crews are out of position, so check your flight status before heading out.
slides.body: A router swap overloaded FAA systems, halting US flights. More than 20,000 flights disrupted since Friday. Crews are out of position, so check your flight status before heading out.

slides.title: US pushes Europe–Russia talks
slides.image_prompt: Two empty chairs facing each other across a long negotiating table, a paper map of Europe spread between them, soft daylight
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Kushner says the US is setting up Europe–Russia talks.
WHY IT MATTERS
He says no Ukraine peace deal works without Europe.
FOR YOU
No deal yet: the last round only planned a prisoner swap and more talks.
slides.body: Kushner says the US is setting up Europe–Russia talks. He says no Ukraine peace deal works without Europe. No deal yet: the last round only planned a prisoner swap and more talks.
slides.credit: Håkan Dahlström from Malmö, Sweden (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

slides.title: Last time before 2023? 9/11
slides.image_prompt: A quiet empty runway at dawn with rows of parked airplanes, runway lights glowing, calm pastel sky
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Friday's halt was the first US nationwide stop since 2023.
WHY IT MATTERS
The one before that came after 9/11.
FOR YOU
Good news: the FAA expects flights back to normal by Sunday night.
slides.body: Friday's halt was the first US nationwide stop since 2023. The one before that came after 9/11. Good news: the FAA expects flights back to normal by Sunday night.
